svg.title: Temporal checkpoints against two selection gates
svg.desc: Aligned rows compare false-safes and whole triplets. Contract-2 has 17 false-safes, failing a maximum of 14, and 51 whole triplets, passing a minimum of 50. No checkpoint shown passes both gates.
